title: Concurrency
description: Practices for shared state, cross-context communication, and synchronization.

practices.title: One owner per piece of mutable state
practices.statement: Prefer message passing: one execution context owns each piece of mutable state.

practices.title: Complete messages at queue boundaries
practices.statement: Pass complete, immutable messages across context boundaries; never share partial buffers.

practices.title: Justify memory ordering
practices.statement: Every atomic or lock-protected access needs a stated happens-before justification.

practices.title: No blocking in constrained contexts
practices.statement: Never block inside interrupt handlers, event loops, or single-threaded executors.

practices.title: Global lock order
practices.statement: Define a global lock order and check every nested acquisition against it.
